Settings.Nexus.Title: Nexus Mods account
Settings.Nexus.Description: Sign in with your Nexus account — browsing and downloading mods uses your account.
Settings.Nexus.OAuth.Waiting: Waiting for confirmation in the browser… (up to 120 s)
Settings.Nexus.ClientIdHint: Client ID of a registered Nexus app. It works as-is by default.
Settings.Nexus.KeyIntro: Paste an API key from Nexus:
Settings.Nexus.OpenApiPage: Where do I get a key?
Settings.Nexus.Trust: Your key and tokens stay on this computer.
Settings.Nexus.Free: No Premium — downloads only from an nxm:// link
Settings.Nexus.Saved: The key works and has been saved.
Settings.Nexus.MemoryOnly: The key works. The system store is unavailable — the key lasts only until this session ends.
Settings.Nexus.InvalidKey: The key contains invalid characters. Paste only the token from API Access.
Settings.Nexus.Deleted: The Nexus key has been removed.
Nexus.Browser.Title: Mod from Nexus Mods
Nexus.Browser.Description: Paste a mod page address or just its number. Without a valid sign-in and an nxm:// link, downloading is not possible.
Nexus.Browser.Author: Author
Nexus.Browser.NxmHint: Signing in alone cannot download a file. On the mod page use "Mod manager download" and paste the nxm:// link here — it carries a short-lived token.
Nexus.Status.Downloaded: File downloaded. The form below has been filled in — check the version and pin the source.
Nexus.Warning.StaleCache: The API request limit is exhausted. Showing the last saved data — refresh after the limit resets.
Nexus.Warning.LimitReached: The hourly or daily API request limit has been reached.
Nexus.Error.KeyMissing: Sign in with Nexus first, or save the API key in settings (Nexus Mods section).
Nexus.Error.KeyInvalid: The API key is invalid or has been revoked.
Nexus.Error.RateLimit: Nexus limited the number of requests. Try again later.
Nexus.Error.NxmRequired: Non-Premium account: downloading works only with an nxm:// link from the browser ("Mod manager download").
Nexus.Error.NxmExpired: The nxm:// link has expired. Copy a new one from the browser.
Nexus.Error.NotFound: Mod or file not found on Nexus Mods.
Nexus.Error.InvalidReference: Enter a valid Nexus Mods page address or mod number.
Nexus.Error.GameMismatch: The link or address belongs to a different game than the selected one.
Nexus.Error.DomainRequired: Enter the full mod page address — the Nexus domain for this game is unknown.
Nexus.Error.InvalidNxm: This is not a valid nxm:// link. Copy it with the "Mod manager download" button.
Nexus.Error.DownloadFailed: Downloading the file from Nexus failed. Try again with a fresh nxm:// link.
Nexus.Error.DownloadBlocked: The download address points to a host outside the trusted Nexus Mods servers. The download was blocked.
Nexus.Error.DownloadTooLarge: The file exceeds the allowed download limit (2 GiB).
Nexus.Error.OAuthFailed: Nexus authorization failed. If you are using public_test, register an application and enter your own Client ID.
Nexus.Error.OAuthTimeout: No confirmation arrived from the browser in time. Try again.
Nexus.Error.OAuthRevoked: Access has been revoked — sign in again or use the API key.
Nexus.Error.OAuthState: The authorization response does not match the session that was started (state). Try again.
Nexus.Error.OAuthUnavailable: Cannot open the browser or start the local OAuth receiver (is port 8642 taken?).
Nexus.Error.SecretStore: Cannot store or read the tokens in the system secret store. Check the Secrets section.
Nexus.Error.Unavailable: Cannot reach Nexus Mods. Check the connection and try again.
